critical_code_review_comments: Login page inputs lack data-testid attributes (login-email/login-password/login-submit-button) despite iteration_1 report referencing them. Testing worked via placeholder+type selectors but adding data-testid would harden future test scripts.

The 'open' deadline_status filter now returns 0 items because the sole dated-open opp (IFA, 2026-07-31, 30 days) falls into 'closing_month' bucket. This is per current logic (days <= 30 → closing_month). Consider whether 'open' should also include 'closing_month/closing_soon' as a superset for UX clarity, since users may expect the 'Open' filter to show everything not closed and not recurring.
